purpose: Narrate observable facts in the original Garden Door teaching game.
memory_policy: No persistent memory; each request sees only the current observation.
context_sources: player question treated as untrusted input

model_choice.live_model: Explicit COURSE_MODEL for the chosen provider; resolved identifier recorded when returned by the API

evaluation_cases: tests/test_game.py and tests/test_providers.py; mocked provider tests are offline; live setup validates one real response
logging_policy: Console shows model identifier, elapsed time and usage. No persistent player text or credentials. Setup report contains metadata only.
human_override_points: continue with authoritative game text after a narration failure
native_artifact: course_game/narrator.py: Python function interface with validated structured output
fallback: The game CLI shows deterministic state on failure. Setup Verification fails on live errors; it never substitutes a fixture.
limitations: Valid JSON and fact IDs do not prove that the narration is true.
Stateless narrator only. The Session 3 examples (player interface, rule-change skill, rules reviewer) exist; the player agent, episode runner and baseline are Session 4 and 5 exercises.
Live model, institutional credits and deployed service are not verified by offline tests.

agent_team.purpose: Build and change the game under the student's direction.
agent_team.tools_and_permissions: The coding assistant's repository read/write and test commands; no credentials, no merge, no gate approval.
agent_team.outputs: A branch, passing tests and a change summary in the rule-change skill's format.
agent_team.handoff: Summary and diff to the rules reviewer; the student opens the PR and links the Asana task.

agent_team.purpose: One procedure for every rule change: map row, failing test, engine change, boundary check, summary.
agent_team.tools_and_permissions: Runs inside the implementation agent with its permissions.
agent_team.outputs: Updated map row, test and summary.
agent_team.handoff: The summary is the reviewer's input.
agent_team.human_approval: The student accepts or rejects the summary's assumptions.

agent_team.purpose: Check evidence, agreement of engine, test and map, test coverage and the playing agent's boundary.
agent_team.tools_and_permissions: Read, Grep, Glob only; a fresh context that did not write the change.
agent_team.outputs: Findings as [blocking | should fix | note] file:line lines, or "No findings".
agent_team.handoff: Findings go to the student, who decides; blocking findings return to the implementation agent.
agent_team.human_approval: The student decides every finding; the reviewer cannot approve or merge.

playing_agent_interface.sees: the results of observe(), legal_actions() and step() only
playing_agent_interface.runner_constraint: The Session 4 runner calls reset and outcome and holds the GardenDoorEpisode object (and its _world); the player receives only observe, legal_actions and step. Python cannot enforce this; a runner test must. Listed as assumed in docs/rule-source-map.md.
